search_text: published ZDI-14-299 ZDI-CAN-2087 SolarWinds Storage Manager AuthenticationFilter Remote Code Execution Vulnerability 2014-08-27 10.0 AV:N/AC:L/Au:N/C:C/I:C/A:C ['SolarWinds'] ['Storage Manager'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of SolarWinds Storage Manager. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the AuthenticationFilter class. The issue lies in the ability to subvert the authentication filter. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to upload malicious scripts that can then be used to execute code under the context of SYSTEM.
